title: expect.json
description: The manifest that makes a directory a conformance case. This schema describes the ENVELOPE only -- the part every kind shares and a runner relies on. The body of the manifest is the kind's own vocabulary and is deliberately unconstrained here; a kind that wants its body checked supplies case-body.schema.json at its fixture root. See CASE-TREE.md.

kind.$comment: The one key a runner reads. It selects the handler that asserts the case, and it is authoritative: the parent directory name is a filing convention, not an input. Kind names are tree-local, not globally registered -- two trees may both use 'merge' and mean different bodies by it.

propertyNames.$comment: The only constraint the envelope places on the case body: keys are lower snake_case. This is a naming convention, not vocabulary -- it says nothing about WHICH keys a kind may use, only how they are spelled, so a tree stays greppable across kinds.
